name: Ifukube Yahiro
source:
Best friend of [url=/c557]Nogisaka Motoka[/url] and proprietor of a family owned candy store, the rogue-looking Yahiro would prefer spending her time sleeping and drinking. In truth, the ill-tempered and sardonic mannerisms hide Yahiro’s true personality: a woman whose past is a field littered with the shattered glass of lost dreams, forgotten promises, and broken romances.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150331123620/http://www.erogereview.com/2009/02/16/yosuga-no-sora/]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
